Create a package that uses RZig

Source: R/create.R
create_rzig_package.Rd

Creates a new package at path: a DESCRIPTION, the RZig scaffold of use_rzig() with its hello_zig() example and help page, and, by default, a testthat suite with one test of hello_zig(). The package builds with R CMD INSTALL once a supported Zig compiler is available (see find_zig()) and passes R CMD check as created.

Usage

create_rzig_package(path, fields = list(), tests = TRUE, ci = FALSE)

Arguments

path

The directory to create. It must not exist or must be empty.

fields

A named list of DESCRIPTION fields that replace or extend the defaults.

tests

If TRUE, add tests/testthat.R and a test of hello_zig(), with testthat in Suggests.

ci

If TRUE, add the GitHub Actions workflow of use_rzig_ci().

Value

The normalized path of the package, invisibly.

Details

The package name is the last component of path. The default DESCRIPTION fields are placeholders for the title, the description and the author; fields replaces or adds fields, for example fields = list(Title = "Fast Rank Statistics", "Authors@R" = 'person("Ada", "Lovelace", email = "ada@example.org", role = c("aut", "cre"))'). The license is GPL-3, the license of the framework sources the package contains (another field value is the package author's choice).

Examples

package_path <- file.path(tempdir(), "zigstats")
create_rzig_package(package_path)
#> Created package zigstats at /tmp/Rtmp7FFeHY/zigstats
#> Write Zig functions in src/rzig/src/main.zig, then run rzig::document(path) and rzig::build_zig(path)
list.files(package_path, recursive = TRUE)
